# CI-only dbt install, consumed by .github/workflows/dbt-run.yml.
# Kept as a file (not an inline `pip install`) so setup-python's pip cache has a
# stable path to hash — the download cache then persists across scheduled runs.
#
# dbt-core is capped below 2.0 on purpose: dbt-postgres==1.10.0 depends on
# dbt-core>=1.8.0rc1 with no upper bound, and that pre-release lower bound lets
# pip pull the Fusion alpha (dbt-core 2.0.0a1) once it hit PyPI. Fusion has no
# Postgres adapter, so it fails immediately (dbt1005).
dbt-core<2.0
dbt-postgres==1.10.0
